annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and Frobenius-norm specialization of one inherited product-error term in equation (8)

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P10 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P10 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p10_t1_inherited_right_product_error {n : Nat} (A dB : P10Matrix n) : p10FrobNorm (p10MatMul n A dB) <= p10FrobNorm A * p10FrobNorm dB
formal_statement.plain_language: The Frobenius norm of the right-input error propagated through a matrix product is at most the product of the left-matrix and right-error norms.

informal_proof: Identify the paper-scoped explicit norm with the matrix Frobenius norm and apply Frobenius submultiplicativity.
informal_statement: The inherited-right-input amplification term from equation (8), specialized to the Frobenius norm.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 108, 2007, printed pages 59-91

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: NumStability.frobNorm_matMul_le in NumStability/Analysis/MatrixAlgebra.lean gives this product estimate directly after identifying the paper-scoped explicit Frobenius norm with the frozen wrapper. Mathlib's Matrix.frobenius_norm_mul is the corresponding underlying theorem.

source_locations.role: amplification of error inherited from the right product input

tier_rationale: NumStability.frobNorm_matMul_le in NumStability/Analysis/MatrixAlgebra.lean states the needed submultiplicative estimate; the L proof only bridges the paper-scoped Frobenius definition to the frozen wrapper and specializes the theorem to A and dB.
